note: Corrections to the OSM data (plan 0005, R7). tools/geo/build.py applies them after it reads the OSM data. Each correction must have a reason. Actions: add_node (tags, lon, lat), add_way (tags and coords as [lon, lat]), set_tags (way and tags; a null value removes the tag), remove_way (way).

corrections.reason: OSM has no object for Núi Nhỏ. The position is the highest point of the Copernicus DEM on the hill (177.9 m), next to the lighthouse.
